[b]Hey everyone![/b]

I apologize for not posting earlier this week, I know some of you have been eagerly waiting to see more about the new upcoming game Chaos Chain, but I have been very sick and in bed most of the time until now. I am finally starting to feel better.

Anyways, today I only have one screenshot to show off a new QOL feature because I have only worked a half day today. Hoping to get more done tomorrow.

[i]Floating Labels[/i]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/fc5e674118fb5e4c1186ce97f7c49c69f0a157b8.png[/img]

This might seem like a minor feature, but in the past with my games, people have mentioned they don't always know or understand what they can interact with. I have always made it so that if you hover the mouse over something that can be used, hover text (labels) appear over top of it. Now, you will have the option to simply toggle them always on. It may get a bit cluttered on the screen in small areas from time to time, but I have the opacity lowered a bit from my other projects to allow better visibility and high-contrast text to be able to properly see the label itself.

I have added an option to the settings menu that allows you to permanently enable or disable floating labels - independently of the mouse. If you disable the feature, you will get labels when you hover over something with the mouse, but they will always be on if the setting is enabled. Some people tend to disable the mouse, but this change will still allow this feature to work.

Something else that is kind of visible in the screenshot is the red diamond over the door. This is just an indicator that I created (it pulses over time) to signify that an otherwise static environmental object (such as a door, trash can, etc) can be interacted with. Doors that can be opened to travel to another area have blue arrows inside of them as well.

That's all for now, thank you for reading. Hopefully, I can have more info and screenshots soon. 

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Chaos Chain - Equipment Briefing
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

[u]For those of you who missed the last announcement discussing my next project[/u], [i]Chaos Chain[/i], you can find that here to get you up to date: 

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/CorrosiveStudios/announcements/detail/5246117291297561777

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/37cf25db4ec95381cb2716184fc089383d55739f.jpg[/img]

[b]For those of you who already know of the new game, let's talk about equipment.[/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/64df151097805d3f020cf38222ae5ff5ab46baa3.png[/img]

[h1]Equipment[/h1] has always played a significant role in my past games. Having the right tools for the job at hand is extremely important in my opinion, so I try to put that into the game worlds.

For [i]Chaos Chain[/i], this will still apply, but the system has been expanded and improved from my other projects.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/e79ae69e93dd2b97e560bd4ca9c4d5fd258f6772.png[/img]

First, as you can hopefully see in the image above, weapons have a pretty significant stat-line. A lot is taken into account and much thought went into how the stats function and what ratings each weapon was given. It may look simplistic, but each specific stat has a lot of factors to think about such as handling, ease of use, accuracy, speed, range, capabilities of fire modes such as semi, burst, and auto. The engine is somewhat limited, but I have done my best so far (still a lot of room for improvement) to make weapons feel unique.

Second, I've done A LOT of work on improving the combat system. I can't really show it off here right now, but something I'd like to mention is an EXTREME focus on sound effects and quick-flow combat. Weapons have unique sound effects and animations so you can tell what you are using compared to your enemies. I have improved the default battle sound system to include a variety of sound effects for each event so it's not always the same exact boring sound. There are several sound effects for each event like for example an evasion/dodge has multiple sounds of its own and then there are special sounds for bullets missing or a melee weapon hitting someone. I personally think that sounds make or break a game - especially when you're hearing the same ones over... and over... and over.

So far, I have around 50 or so weapons which are mostly melee weapons and improvised weapons, but I have a handful of fictional (based on real) firearms across a variety of different archtypes including pistols, PDWs (personal defense weapons), SMGs (submachine guns), shotguns, assault rifles, battle rifles, carbines, sniper rifles, machine guns, rocket launchers, grenade launchers, special weapons, and even some exotic weaponry. Not all of these are ready yet, but that's the weapon archtype/class lineup I'm going for. Like in my first game, [i]Waste Walkers[/i], firearms will allow for different ammunition types such as full metal jacket, hollow point, armor piercing, buckshot, slugshot, and birdshot, and even more are planned to be added. Depending on your preference, the different ammunitions will provide different bonuses.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/dc388ee7d346efb58f2c76172103a2de5ecb95a9.png[/img]

Armor is the same way - they have a lot to take into account. One flaw of my previous games in my opinion is that armor resistances were very minor. A 5% here, maybe a lucky 15% there, etc. The idea was to stack up on resistances you favored with your combination of chosen gear. Most of the time, the numbers didn't add up enough to actually make any significant impact. That will NOT be the case here. The equipment slot system is more straight forward, but each slot has a specific purpose. Armor is armor. It should feel like it. In the above picture, you can see the current (subject to change) stats for the ballistic vest. The resistance percentages are high enough by themselves to actually protect you from different damage types, but they may be bolstered even more by accompanying gear in other slots such as the head slot for headgear or even the accessory slot.

Theoretically speaking, if your punk has 8 health remaining and an enemy thug stabs you with a shiv for 10 puncture damage (lucky roll) and you have a protection (armor) value of 2, a toughness of 4, and a 25% puncture resistance, you'll only take 3 damage. The detailed math: 10 damage - (2 protection - 4 toughness) * .75 = 3. That's pretty helpful. Taking a third of the dealt damage because of having decent armor instead of the full amount just kept you alive. A leather jacket (armor 1 with a puncture protection of 5%) would have left you dead in the street. The differences between armor types should no longer feel minimal.

That's all for now, I'll have more information soon!

Thanks for reading!

-[b]Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia

notes.title: What's Next from Corrosive Studios? "Chaos Chain"
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone, Corrosion here.[/b]

So, several people have been asking me recently about what I've been working on lately.

I didn't want to give any info out too early, but I think now is a great time for me to tell you all a bit about my new project. 

Let me start by saying that it's very early in development, so nothing you see is finalized.

[h2]Chaos Chain[/h2]
[i]A dark cyberpunk roleplaying game by Corrosive Studios[/i]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/37cf25db4ec95381cb2716184fc089383d55739f.jpg[/img]

-This is a project that I have been working on for a few months and it's finally starting to actually take form. The game is heavily inspired by a variety of movies and games including The Matrix, Johnny Mnemonic, Shadowrun, The Terminator, Total Recall, Repo Men, Cyberpunk 2021 (RPG), and a whole lot more. Of course, I'm only trying to get inspiration for the genre, so Chaos Chain will have a lot of its own content and lore. I'm really passionate about bringing this all to life, so I hope some of you like it so far.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/ad37bef03793018501f2f1a2c1573b88391c1e1a.gif[/img]

[h2]Background:[/h2]
[i]"Half a century into the future, mankind's world is riven and in a state of great social, political, and economic strain... After the end of the horrific pandemic that haunted the early twenties, big pharma became stronger than ever seen before. Medical research thrived and allowed for a multitude of tech advancements, but healthcare prices skyrocketed, causing mass inflation and shifting the world's economy... As a result, cryptocurrencies grew in popularity and eventually gained enough momentum to replace other monetary systems across the globe... Greed, hatred, envy, and panic then fueled the fires of war time after time, leaving the world scarred and broken. The U.N. has fallen and the war on terror has failed. Civilization is slowly collapsing in on itself... Now, most people cannot afford their basic needs. Society is fragmented and has dissolved back into a rigid caste division. Crime is at an all-time high and poverty is the new norm. Each day that passes, exploitation of the Earth's resources continues and pollution intensifies, making life even more unbearable... Humanity is in the darkest place of its entire existence... A dark place where you exist."[/i]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/fecced5e2930fa5078cdd9757356c4f6e914ceb0.jpg[/img]

[u]It's still very early off, and it will be a bit before anything is playable, but it's getting there.[/u]

-For the game's mechanics, I have read through a lot of reviews and feedback that I've gained over the years. I tried to create a good mix of both complexity and simplicity to make the game straight forward, but also unique, also while being enjoyable. There is no durability, no overly complicated armor systems, damage is straight forward, weapons and classifications for them are easy to understand, and so on.

-I want to create a game with a HEAVY EMPHASIS ON ACTUAL ROLEPLAYING. In the past, I did this with Lawless Lands, but I want it to have even more depth. Branching dialogues, non-linear sequences, player-influenced-events based on choices and character builds, and many other ideas. I want the player's place in the game to have a direct tie in to what they do. For better or for worse. I also want to highlight that the game will not be combat focused. It will still feature combat though. [b]Basically, I just really want the game to be much more dynamic and personalized based on how the player interacts with the game world.[/b]

-Combat as it is right now, is quick, painful, and dirty. Even if you have a clear advantage, you're still likely to come out with some scratches on you. Of course, armor will help - and much more effectively than my previous games at that. Weapon capabilities are also more diversified and streamlined, making them more useful depending on the situation. I've already made changes (a lot) to the combat system to make it more enjoyable and dangerous. For you and the enemies. I've also decided to make custom animations for EVERY WEAPON so it may take longer, but I think it'll make it a lot better. 

-The game is not always meant to be perfectly "fair", but that counts for everyone. What I mean is, if you can do something, your enemy likely can to and vice versa, but sometimes you may find yourself in a serious bind and you'll need to play your cards carefully to get yourself out.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/9183f8dbd6c925d659fee4a7908686336dff2dbf.jpg[/img]

-I'm pretty much building it from the ground up from scratch, creating a lot of custom assets (and a friend is helping me with character design stuff) so it will take time, but it will also be much more original. For music (soundtracks), I have a really awesome selection that fits my vision perfectly. I'm really excited to see it all put together.

-For character creation/design, I can say that there is a TON OF DEPTH. Skills, attributes, traits, flaws (something new that I wanted to do), occupation, etc. Characters are not all-powerful. They have limits and drawbacks. Psychological trauma and defects as well as physical with varying effects. Backgrounds will give key bonuses in various areas of influence that can help or hinder you in situations depending on what you have available. There are also going to be more out of combat skills so the game has more variety.

There is a lot more I want to talk about and show off, but this is already turning into a novel, so I will wrap it up for now.

If you want to discuss the game, give ideas, or just have the link to the hub, you can find a link to the Chaos Chain Steam Community Hub here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1536730

I'll have more information soon.

Thanks for reading!

[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/1a3994ccd145768199bf31edb79d01bdea1cb37d.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/551a162736ad2ccd578f3145ff1e02529870d419.png[/img][/url]

-[b]Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia

notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

Hey everyone!

This is a QOL update and also to implement the upcoming Chaotic Wastes Expansion DLC.

[b]Update 2.1.0 Change Log:[/b]

Changes & Additions:
-Reorganized the intro text to be more easily readable

-Tinted the intro image to better fit the game
-Set a specific music track for the intro scene

-Added handlers for the incoming Chaotic Wastes Expansion
-Added 11 different World Modifiers for the Chaotic Wastes Expansion

Now let's look at the expansion details.

"[b]Chaotic Wastes Expansion DLC:[/b]

The Chaotic Wastes Expansion for Waste Walkers adds an extra system for replayability and for creating unique playthroughs and challenges. The system will randomly select 3 of 11 possible world modifiers that each have a unique effect on gameplay and the game world. These may be rerolled up to 5 times so you can choose which ones you want to play with. It can either be activated by starting a new game, or by simply accessing your personal stash in your home.

[list]
[*]Chaotic Combat: All hit point damage in battle can be up to 2 points higher.
[*]Prepper: Start at level 2, but enemies may also start 1 level higher.
[*]Sadism: All criticals count for 3x damage instead of the standard 2x damage.
[*]SSDD: No effects good or bad. You got lucky.
[*]Slim Pickings: All enemies have 10% less health, but 5% more accuracy and evasion.
[*]Contamination: All pre-bomb food items give radiation, but are more abundant.
[*]Lonely Road: You cannot have a companion (at least until you gain the leadership trait), but your character gains several buffs.
[*]Mad Mutants: All mutants gain 15 bonus initiative and 5% critical chance, but lose 10% hit points and morale.
[*]Skillful: Gain 10% more experience, but enemies are 10% more likely to target you.
[*]Desolate: It is much more likely to storm and weather changes more rapidly.
[*]Combat Training: You gain 5% accuracy and evasion, but earn 20% less experience.

notes.title: 3/10/21 Gamepad/Controller Support Update 2.0.5
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

Hey everyone!

Like my other two games, Lawless Lands and Disgraced, I have added gamepad and controller support for Waste Walkers!

It's been a long time coming, but I finally had time to really investigate this and get it sorted.

It's not perfect, but I've done a lot of testing with my xbox-360/xbox-one controller and it's working.

[b]IN ORDER TO TOGGLE BETWEEN KEYBOARD OR GAMEPAD, THERE IS A FILE IN THE GAME'S INSTALL DIRECTORY CALLED "gamepad.txt"!

TYPING "1" INTO THE FILE WILL ENABLE THE GAMEPAD AND DISABLE THE ADVANCED KEYBOARD SUPPORT.

TYPING "0" INTO THE FILE WILL ENABLE THE ADVANCED KEYBOARD SUPPORT AND DISABLE THE GAMEPAD.

BASED ON ENGINE LIMITATIONS, THIS IS THE ONLY WAY I HAVE FOUND TO DO THIS.

YOU MAY NEED TO RUN THE GAME AS ADMINISTRATOR FOR THIS TO WORK.[/b]

Here is a guide on how to use it: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2420644683

This change applies to the game and the expansions!

Update 2.0.5 Change Log:

Changes & Additions:
-Added "gamepad.txt" File to the Install Directory with a Default Setting of "0" (the gamepad is disabled and the advanced keyboard is enabled / setting to "1" will reverse the effect)
-Added a Default Control Scheme for Gamepads

You should NOT need to start a new game.

If you have any issues or concerns, please let me know.

The update will be available publicly soon.

-Corrosion

[b]Arise:[/b]
[list]
Plunge into the Lawless Lands of Crossia, a once great kingdom where chaos slowly consumes more and more of the country. The cities have plummeted into poverty and crime, and the surrounding countryside is littered with famine and death. notes.title: Details of Our Next Project - Affliction
notes.content:
[h1][b]Affliction[/b][/h1]

[i]Based in the fictitious Eastern European country of Ghulovka, amidst a terrible political crisis, [b]Affliction[/b] allows players to take on the role of a patient who awakes in a bizarre research facility. With no memory of their reason for being there, players are forced to fight for their survival while frantically seeking answers to discover the truth behind their identity and unveil the mystery surrounding the horrific purpose of the facility.[/i]

[b]Affliction[/b] is a dark action/adventure game designed to engage players with its surreal lore that features a thrilling storyline where players must fight, scavenge, and use anything at their disposal to its full potential if they hope to escape and live to tell the tale. Players will experience the terrifying possibilities of chemical and biological warfare from a first person perspective. The game features many different locations to explore including a disturbing research facility, a dark wilderness, a desolate city, and more. Exploration can be rewarding, but it can also be very unforgiving. Players are advised to use extreme caution.

[b]Gameplay Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Gripping Storyline With a Blend of Action, Adventure, Horror, Thriller, and Sci Fi Elements
[*]Open World Exploration
[*]Diverse & Unique Characters
[*]Multiple Weapons to Choose From
[*]Lore Items to Further the Story
[*]Numerous Locations to Explore
[*]Several Different Enemies
[*]Environmental Interaction
[*]Basic Resource Management System

notes.title: Details of Our Next Project - Affliction
notes.content:
[h1][b]Affliction[/b][/h1]

[i]Based in the fictitious Eastern European country of Ghulovka, amidst a terrible political crisis, [b]Affliction[/b] allows players to take on the role of a patient who awakes in a bizarre research facility. With no memory of their reason for being there, players are forced to fight for their survival while frantically seeking answers to discover the truth behind their identity and unveil the mystery surrounding the horrific purpose of the facility.[/i]

[b]Affliction[/b] is a dark action/adventure game designed to engage players with its surreal lore that features a thrilling storyline where players must fight, scavenge, and use anything at their disposal to its full potential if they hope to escape and live to tell the tale. Players will experience the terrifying possibilities of chemical and biological warfare from a first person perspective. The game features many different locations to explore including a disturbing research facility, a dark wilderness, a desolate city, and more. Exploration can be rewarding, but it can also be very unforgiving. Players are advised to use extreme caution.

notes.title: [Final Release] 12/1/15 Update 1.7.8
notes.content:
[i]Waste Walkers[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cyhnv0q.png[/img]
It's finally here!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/371100/

Ahead of schedule and above and beyond, Waste Walkers is ready for final release! After the last three days and nights of constant work, the development road has finally come to an end and it even came 2 entire months early! Waste Walkers was on Steam [u]exactly[/u] 6 months in early access and is finally out and in full release! It has been one heck of a journey for me and I am sure it has been for all of you out there supporting me too. I would like to thank everyone who has helped me reach this goal and thank everyone who believed in me. I hope you'll be satisfied with the game the way it turned out. Simply put, the game wouldn't be what it is today without all of your help and support and I recognize that. Since the beginning, I have tried to be transparent in my actions, let my project be community driven, and keep to an honest and straight forward attitude with my customers. I hope you can all agree that I have kept to my words and been a community developer. This game is not planned to be my last and infact, I am already moving toward starting a new, even more ambitious project by myself. I would love for you all to join me once again in crafting a game that we can all love and enjoy. I will always actively take advice and feedback from players for my games and do my best to keep everyone happy. Now... for the moment you've all been waiting for: the final release notes: ːWWBackpackː

[b]Version 1.7.8 Change Log:[/b] ːWWGasmaskː

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed numerous typos
-Fixed some errors related to achievements failing to unlock
-Fixed some messed up radiation tiles
-Fixed all known pathing bugs and clipping errors
-Fixed quest glitches
-Fixed some journal bugs
-Fixed sound bugs
-Fixed a fatal crash caused by an achievement failure to unlock
-Fixed journal crash where wrong sound effect was loaded
-Removed some music files from the soundtrack list (They didn't fit in with the game)
-Removed tons of excess files

Changes & Additions:
-Greatly polished the game
-Added a text string to the in game map that says "Home" to show you where your house is
-Added some dynamic parts to the main storyline
-Added the colony system
-Added colony upgrades
-Added colony raids
-Added pipe shotgun
-Updated all shop listings
-Finalized the city map
-Added dozens of characters that go to the colony as it progresses
-Added personal traits earned from making the colony
-Added "Leadership" colony trait - allows you to have an additional active companion
-Added "Tactican" colony trait - +5 initiative
-Finished the main storyline (Be warned, it's a sad ending)
-Added 5 more parts to the main storyline (Don't want to ruin what happens with names"
-Added "Stuck" side quest
-Added "A Home of Our Own" side quest
-Added "Water is Life" side quest
-Added "Food is a Chance" side quest
-Added "The Power of Gasoline" side quest
-Added "Shackled" side quest
-Added schematics for a few more items
-Added meeting office area
-Finalized the eco-center area
-Added chop shop area
-Added old warehouse area
-Added a few more destroyed buildings to the city map
-Added boarded shack area
-Added call center area
-Added day care center area
-Added computer repair area
-Added greenhouse area
-Added a lot more debris to the city map
-Added more wreckage and blockades to the city map
-Added a lot more radiated puddles to the city map
-Added a lot more loot spawns
-Added "Mist" anomaly
-Added some more swamp lands to the city map
-Added a lot more enemy spawns
-Balanced loot spawns
-Added some weapons to the misc items loot roster
-Increased time in between random ambushes
-Modified some areas
-Greatly modified the intro
-Modified the starting loadout
-Modified some skill descriptions
-Balanced all enemies
-Balanced some equipment
-Added some new achievements
-Added some new unique rewards for completing certain tasks
-Updated the city map in the game folder

Resource Toolkit Purchasers:
All new sprites, battlers, and some other assets have been added to the resource toolkit dlc folder.

NOTE: [u]OLD SAVES WILL BE CORRUPT. PLEASE START A NEW GAME WHEN UPDATING FROM THE BETA TO THE FINAL RELEASE. SORRY FOR THE INCONVENIENCE THIS MAY HAVE CAUSED. YOU SHOULD NOT HAVE TO DO THIS AGAIN.[/u]

There are more additions and changes than listed above but I want all of you to be able to discover them! I want to let Waste Walkers speak for itself. ːWWPKː

If there are any bugs, please let me know and I will fix them as soon as I hear of them. You all deserve a decent, bug free game. ːWWFAKː

Again, thank you all so much for your assistance in making Waste Walkers truly come to life! When I have a good enough start on my next project, I'll be putting it on Greenlight for everyone to check out! I hope you'll consider voting on my next item for me! ːWWCrowbarː

[i]As always, be safe Waste Walkers[/i].

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Status Update - 1.7.4
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cyhnv0q.png[/img]

As you all should know, Waste Walkers is nearing the end of it's development phase. The last update that was released was the latest stable build and the game will stay in this build for some time. This will allow players to play the game and enjoy it without needing to update and reset their progress. This also gives me time to work on finalizing the game. There isn't much mapping left to do but there are still some things that I still plan to add. The player managed colony system, the faction system, more quests, more enemies, more items, more equipment, finalizing the main story line, and finishing the city map once and for all are on my list of things to do. That being said, you'll find a list below of things I have been working on recently.

-Added an underground collapsed & flooded metro (This will add a "dungeon crawling" experience) (Thanks to Resi for his help)
-Man holes to allow entry to the metro
-New equipment options
-New items
-Better sound effects for the environment
-Bug fixes
-Optimization
-More dialogue options
-Overall balance
-Much more

This is an overly simplified list but it will give you some insight on what I have been doing these last few days. The next update won't be out for awhile but rest assured, progress is being made and the next update will be worth the wait. If anyone would like to continue to show their support in the mean time, feel free to grab one of the DLCs that might interest you.

[i]As always, be safe Waste Walkers[/i].

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Status Update - 1.6.0
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Waste Walkers! This is just a quick status update to let everyone know that 1.6.0 will be coming out in a few days. The update will have a lot of new content and quite a bit of polishing. One important feature that has been added is the tutorial. After creating your character, you'll be asked if you want to view the tutorial. It is a total of 10 slides that provide basic but valuable information about the core aspects of the game. The player managed colony floor plans are finished and now the systems and advanced functionality are all that is left. The colony system won't be fully released in 1.6.0, but it will be soon. This is going to take some time, so please be patient. We'll have it out as soon as we possibly can. As many of you know, we try to provide quality and quantity so we're going to try making it as bug-free as possible. That being said, the update will also include multiple bug fixes as well as improvements regarding some of the features in game like the quest system. If anyone has any requests or ideas for things they'd like to see in the colony system, please feel free to open a thread on the forums or reply in the comments for this announcement. Update 1.6.0 will be released within the next couple of days. We hope you're as excited as we are about the new update!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 8/21/15 Update 1.5.9
notes.content:
This update brings a couple of huge additions and ideas to the game world. First off, [u]saving has been disabled from the menu[/u]. Don't panic, there is a solution. Players must sleep in a secured area. Secured areas have beds that can be used to sleep in. [u]Players will be brought to the save screen when a bed is slept in[/u]. Players can also get sleeping bags that allow them to save anywhere they want. Sleeping is important and it is vital for the survival of your character. Before, the beds were almost completely useless. Now, they are important. This change will make players carefully consider each and every move they make. This also gives players the sense of having a place to call home or a hide out to rest their head and stash their loot. When the player created base building system is added to the game, this will act as a permanent shelter for characters to save. Another important notable change is to the radiation system. The sound and the image that normally are played and shown while taking radiation only play when players are on a radiated tile. Players can still take radiation after they leave the tile but only for a few seconds. This change was made due to the amount of bugs and problems the old system caused. The last huge change note is the police station area. The police station has finally been added and it is by far the largest area yet. It has a jail in the basement level, the ground floor has offices and briefing rooms, and the second floor has the chief's office and the armory. Players now have the chance to explore and raid a full police station.

[b]Update 1.5.9 Change Log:[/b]

notes.title: 8/21/15 Update 1.5.9
notes.content:
This update brings a couple of huge additions and ideas to the game world. First off, [u]saving has been disabled from the menu[/u]. Don't panic, there is a solution. Players must sleep in a secured area. Secured areas have beds that can be used to sleep in. [u]Players will be brought to the save screen when a bed is slept in[/u]. Players can also get sleeping bags that allow them to save anywhere they want. Sleeping is important and it is vital for the survival of your character. Before, the beds were almost completely useless. Now, they are important. This change will make players carefully consider each and every move they make. This also gives players the sense of having a place to call home or a hide out to rest their head and stash their loot. When the player created base building system is added to the game, this will act as a permanent shelter for characters to save. Another important notable change is to the radiation system. The sound and the image that normally are played and shown while taking radiation only play when players are on a radiated tile. Players can still take radiation after they leave the tile but only for a few seconds. This change was made due to the amount of bugs and problems the old system caused. The last huge change note is the police station area. The police station has finally been added and it is by far the largest area yet. It has a jail in the basement level, the ground floor has offices and briefing rooms, and the second floor has the chief's office and the armory. Players now have the chance to explore and raid a full police station.

[b]Update 1.5.9 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed multiple dialogue bugs

The next update won't be for awhile since it is a new build (1.6.0) but it will be worth it. The base building system will be implemented and the factions will begin to take form somewhere in the next build and other features will continue to be expanded upon.

notes.title: 8/14/15 Update 1.5.8
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/E94JqqR.png[/img]

This update brings some features into their finalized forms. The intro to the game is finished and the beginning is completely done. This update should also increase the overall difficulty of the game. The loot tables have been significantly modified to lower the chance to find supplies. All supplies should be treated as a gift. Even useless junk. It can be traded for better supplies and equipment. Enemies are a huge threat and you should never be a hero... even if you're totally stocked on high quality gear. All it takes is one mistake and you could wind up as a meal for a mutant or a prize for a raider. Many features are going to be finished up in the very near future and the game will begin to take it's final form. All that's left is mainly mapping, quests, equipment and some last additions.

notes.title: 7/24/15 Update 1.5.4
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a few pathing errors
-Fixed a bug with the compelled quest
-Fixed bugs with all of the riot controllers (They had very high armor and were never updated when the armor update came out.)
-Fixed a money exploit
-Fixed some item descriptions
-Fixed some item effects
-Fixed some equipment not appearing in shops
-Fixed a bug where items wouldn't be given to players at the end of battle if their inventory was full or over the limit

Additions & Changes:
-Rebalanced the inventory limit system
(Characters each now have 50 carry capacity by default. All items, armor, and weapons have been resized. You may now sprint if you're overencumbered but you still move slower.)
-Radiation deposits now stay around areas with heavy metal content (vehicles)
-Added many more radiated areas
-Lowered current party capacity to 2 from 4 (Players now must choose which companion they want to accompany them. Players can still get as many companions as they want, but they can no longer have multiple followers at the same time.)

-Corrosion ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 6/13/15 Update 1.3.8 With Escape 2.0
notes.content:
===Escape 2.0===
Escape 2.0 has been implemented. When you choose the "Flight" option in combat, enemies will be pushed a space away from you on the map so that you have a narrow oppurtunity of retreat. Random encounters (ambushes) will not be pushed back but aborted. Since all encounters on the map are single enemies at once (unless scripted otherwise), you have a chance to escape that specific conflict. If you find yourself surrounded by multiple foes on the map, you'd better get away quickly. You'll be surrounded if you don't. Also, all characters Dexterity (DEX) is now accounted for instead of just the main character and the first enemy of each troop. Successful escapes will be determined by a DEX check for both teams and the player's team will need to be a bit higher in order to succeed.

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed pathing problems
-Fixed quest bugs with nurse at New Veil
-Item art fixes

Additions:
-German Shepard (Nadia) companion now available after a short mini quest

Changes:
-Escape changes
-Old house above beginning basement increased in size and contents
-Explorable house in southern neighborhood is now larger and contains more loot
-Art for some items fixed or changed
-Removed extra assets that weren't game related and unused

ːCStudː
